scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @roadreach/contracts && concurrently -n contracts,server,client -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @roadreach/contracts" "npm run dev --workspace @roadreach/server" "npm run dev --workspace @roadreach/client"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @roadreach/contracts && npm run build --workspace @roadreach/server && npm run build --workspace @roadreach/client
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace @roadreach/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @roadreach/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @roadreach/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @roadreach/client
